paper_title: Search for QCD coupled axion dark matter with the MICROSCOPE space experiment
coupling_convention: 1/f_a in GeV^-1 (axion-gluon coupling, inverse of Peccei-Quinn scale)
notes: Reanalysis of MICROSCOPE UFF (equivalence principle) space mission data searching for QCD-coupled axion DM via the axion-gluon coupling 1/f_a. 95% CL exclusion covers m_a from 1e-20 to ~1e-13 eV (Fig. 2), improving lab bounds by up to 2 orders of magnitude for 1e-17 to 1e-13 eV. Only two explicit numerical anchor points given in text: strongest limit 1/f_a ~ 1.7e-16 GeV^-1 at m_a = 1e-20 eV, weakening to 1/f_a ~ 1.3e-10 GeV^-1 at m_a ~ 7.7e-14 eV; full curve is in Fig. 2 (not digitizable from text) and contains narrow blind bands where the signal gamma crosses zero. Assumes rho_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 and stochastic (Rayleigh-distributed) field amplitude with Bayesian (Jeffreys prior) inference.
